description: This file defines a utility class 'MappingTimer' used for creating and managing timers to measure the performance of mapping operations within the connectivity messaging component of the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods to start timers for inbound and outbound message mappings, and to measure the execution time of specific code blocks or suppliers, capturing success or failure via tagging.

classes.name: MappingTimer
classes.description: A utility class for creating and managing timers for measuring segments of message mapping operations, including inbound/outbound distinction, payload, and protocol segments.

methods.name: inbound
methods.description: Creates a new MappingTimer instance for inbound message mapping, tagged accordingly.

methods.name: outbound
methods.description: Creates a new MappingTimer instance for outbound message mapping, tagged accordingly.

methods.name: overall
methods.description: Measures the execution time of a Runnable block.

methods.name: overall
methods.description: Measures the execution time of a Supplier and returns its result.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Measures the execution time of a Supplier within a 'payload' segment and tags with the mapper ID.

methods.name: protocol
methods.description: Measures the execution time of a Supplier within a 'protocol' segment.

methods.name: timed
methods.description: Helper method to measure execution of a Supplier with tagging.

methods.name: timed
methods.description: Helper method to measure execution of a Runnable with tagging.

methods.name: startNewTimer
methods.description: Creates and starts a new expiring timer with tags for connection ID and type.
